title: Bigger shared campaigns
summary: Shared campaigns can now grow to 4 MB, more than twice as large as before, and only what changed is downloaded after the first load.
items: A shared campaign can hold up to 4 MB (it was 1.8 MB). Map images and archived session reports are stored separately and still do not count.
After the first load, players and the DM download only the parts of the campaign that changed, such as the newest chat lines.
When a large campaign takes a while to load, a loading screen shows the progress. Keep waiting continues in the background; Go back pauses the download until you choose Continue loading.
The fog-size warning and the Help guides state the new limit.
